name: Dan tranh call and answer
desc: A spacious, contemplative dan tranh in E minor pentatonic built as a two-section arrange() mini-form: a bending dan_tranh_vibrato 'question' phrase answered by a plucked dan tranh 'response', with a held tremolo pad beneath. Long echoes, opposite-phase filter and pan breaths, reversed-bar punctuation. Floating and meditative where the sibling runs. scale-sub transposable.

gain.doc: level (plucked strings are quiet - keep high)

code.peak: arrange([4, stack(n("<[0 2 4 5 7] [7 5 4 2 0] [4 5 7 9 11] [7 5 4 2 0]>").scale("${root}${oct}:${mode}").s("dantranh").clip(1).gain(${gain}*.9).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.36)), n("<4 7 9 7>").scale("${root}${oct}:${mode}").s("dantranh_tremolo").clip(1).gain(${gain}*.55).shape(.18))], [4, stack(n("<[7 9 11 9 7] [4 5 7 5 4] [0 2 4 7 4] [2 0 2 4 ~]>").scale("${root}${oct}:${mode}").s("dantranh_vibrato").clip(1.5).gain(${gain}*.9).off(1/4, x=>x.add(note(7)).gain(.4)), n("<7 4 7 9>").scale("${root}${oct}:${mode}").s("dantranh_tremolo").clip(1).gain(${gain}*.55).shape(.18))]).pan(sine.range(.3,.7).slow(12)).lpf(sine.range(2600,6500).slow(16)).delay(${dly}).delaytime(.25).delayfeedback(.3).room(.35).every(4, x=>x.rev()).orbit(5).play()
